summary: Vehicle stuck about 9 miles in on Rollins Pass with its occupants stranded as a winter storm moved in; Gilpin County Sheriff's Office referred the 6:45 p.m. 911 relay call to Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery, whose SAR-ES team was paged for a person extraction; the team reached the vehicle, found everyone uninjured and in good spirits, recovered the vehicle before snow could trap it, and all parties were off the trail by midnight.
responding_agency: Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery; Gilpin County Sheriff's Office
notes: First live call for the CO4x4R&R SAR-ES team (founding report notes it had been training for months); handled as a non-emergent extraction so other emergency resources could stay available; vehicle recovery done same night to prevent it being trapped by incoming snow.
